title_zh: Meta-Harness：模型 harness 的端到端优化

title_zh: 面向超表面逆向设计的自进化智能体框架
one_line: A meta-agent revises human-readable skill files from per-task solver feedback; elitist selection on validation success keeps only strictly better skill files.

title_zh: 跨异构任务的自进化 LLM 记忆抽取
one_line: CluE clusters training logs by extraction scenario, analyzes each cluster separately, then synthesizes cross-cluster insights to rewrite the memory-extraction prompt.
one_line_zh: CluE 按抽取场景对训练日志聚类，逐簇分析后综合跨簇洞察，改写记忆抽取提示词。

one_line: A reasoning model iteratively rewrites a user-profile system prompt by critiquing simulated versus real dialogues; profiles then feed SFT and RL training of the simulator.
